title.zh: 囚徒困境与演化博弈 · 合作怎样活下来
title.en: The Prisoner’s Dilemma & Evolutionary Games · How Cooperation Survives

desc.zh: 一次博弈里背叛划算；重复博弈、种群演化里，“以牙还牙”式的合作可以活下来——条件是什么，页面里一格一格调出来。
desc.en: In a one-shot game, defecting pays; in repeated games and evolving populations tit-for-tat style cooperation can survive — and the page lets you tune the conditions.
